'''Energy shell launchers''' were [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile weapons]] mounted on [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]].<ref name="Invasion" /> Six launch tubes were mounted on the [[Tank/Legends|tank]], spaced along the front side of the [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. The launchers fired standard [[energy shell]]s, and carried a payload of up to fifty-five shells. To reload, the tank withdrew to a [[reload station]] where the lower portion of the AAT was removed and a fresh, fully-loaded replacement was put in its place.<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
